name: Introvert
source:
Maxim Zaslavsky's new apartment is a whole different reality, in which there's no place for outside problems: People, conversation or any interaction at all. But this fragile, intimate world of his gets turned over by the appearance of a mysterious girl.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1235950/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
马克西姆·扎斯拉夫斯基 (Maxim Zaslavsky) 的新公寓是一个完全不同的现实，其中没有任何外部问题的空间：人、谈话或任何互动。但他这个脆弱、亲密的世界却因为一个神秘女孩的出现而被颠覆。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1235950/]Steam[/url]]
